title: TRAVEL Italy CAP stop
description: Canonical TRAVEL Italy CAP record. The technical JSON structure is kept identical to the Czechia canonical schema; only country-specific meanings and authorities are adapted for Italy.

city.description: All official Comuni whose territory is included in this CAP area, written in one string and separated by commas. Do not select a single Comune based on the location of a post office. Determine the complete CAP geography from authoritative postal and geographic sources; facts are researched across the whole CAP area.

district.description: A relevant documented sub-municipal locality, frazione, quartiere, rione or other subdivision within the CAP area, not a substitute for listing Comuni. Use null when no precise sub-municipal value is relevant. Never place other Comuni here.

county.description: All applicable current intermediate administrative areas (normally Province or Città metropolitane) covering the Comuni included in this CAP, written in one string and separated by commas when more than one applies. Do not derive this field solely from a post-office address.

state.description: All applicable Regioni covering the Comuni included in this CAP, written in one string and separated by commas when more than one applies. Do not derive this field solely from a post-office address.

representative_place.description: One simple, identifiable orientation anchor for the whole CAP area; it need not be a tourist attraction or geometric centroid and does not designate a representative Comune or the location of a serving post office.

representative_point.description: Souřadnice orientačního reprezentativního místa PSČ; nejde o polohu konkrétního faktu ani o přístupový bod.

access_point.description: A separate practical navigation point for vehicle approach. Use null if it has no clear practical purpose or has not been reliably verified.

plz_source.description: The concrete source used to verify the CAP. Poste Italiane is the primary authority for current CAP assignments and serving-office information; ISTAT is authoritative for Comune and administrative classifications. Geographic assignment of specific addresses and places must be checked with competent official geographic/address sources. Do not treat third-party directories as the canonical postal authority.

postcode_authority.description: Authority for official CAP registration and classification: Poste Italiane. ISTAT is used for official Comune and administrative classifications; geographic assignment of addresses and fact locations must be checked against competent official geographic/address sources. This text field preserves compatibility with the shared TRAVEL record structure.

postcode_source_dataset.description: Name/version of the postal or geographic reference dataset actually used, if available.

postcode_source_release.description: Release or snapshot identifier of the reference dataset actually used, if available.

postcode_source_checked_at.description: Date on which the relevant CAP assignment was checked.

delivery_office_note.description: Documented note about postal-office or delivery arrangements where relevant. A branch address within a CAP does not by itself prove that it exclusively serves the CAP or defines the complete CAP geography.

geographic_authority.description: Authority used for the relevant territorial information. Use ISTAT for current Comune and administrative classifications, Poste Italiane for CAP assignment, and competent official regional/municipal geographic or address datasets for specific geographic positions. This text field preserves compatibility with the shared TRAVEL record structure.

translations.description: Seven language objects required by the shared TRAVEL technical record structure: cs, de, en, es, fr, it and nl.

district_type.description: Optional clarification of the type of district/locality within the CAP area: municipal_part = official municipal subdivision; municipal_district = municipal district; city_quarter = city quarter or neighborhood; settlement = settlement within a Comune; locality = another local area. This field does not replace the complete Comune list in city.

status.description: Technical publication lifecycle. Must match the Neon workflow_status column exactly.

data_version.description: Content version: 1 after rework; 5 after successful final audit and explicit publication.

location.description: Samostatná geografická poloha objektu nebo místa, kterého se konkrétní fakt týká. Nekopíruj sem representative_point ani access_point. Pole zůstává volitelné; pokud nelze obhajitelnou polohu doložit, použij null. Nevyřazuj kvůli tomu zajímavost a nepřidávej nový stav ani příznak; geografické přiřazení se může prověřit při finálním auditu.

map_category.description: Exactly one stable, language-neutral map category for the fact's primary subject. Used for future map iconography only; the existing category field retains its broader editorial meaning. Independent of the fact's physical location.

name.description: Název konkrétního objektu, místa nebo historicky doložené lokality.

address.description: Ověřená poštovní adresa, pokud existuje; jinak null.

type.description: Řízený český slovník typů polohy faktu v jednotném čísle. postal_area označuje faktum vztahující se k oblasti PSČ bez jediného konkrétního fyzického místa.

accuracy.description: exact = ověřený bod objektu; approximate = známá lokalita s nepřesným bodem; area_representative = reprezentativní bod rozlehlého území; historical_approximate = doložená historická poloha s nejistým přesným umístěním.

source.description: Přímá URL dokládající identifikaci místa nebo jeho geografickou polohu.

fact_location.description: Geografická poloha konkrétního faktu podle pravidel českého Content Standardu. Uveď location, pokud lze doložit přesnou nebo obhajitelnou přibližnou polohu; jinak použij null. Zajímavost kvůli chybějící přesné adrese nevyřazuj. Nezaváděj nový stav ani příznak a nikdy automaticky nekopíruj representative_point ani access_point.

$comment: ITALY CONTENT STANDARD: The JSON structure, field names, required/optional/null behavior, source object structure, translation structure, fact-location structure and controlled enums are kept technically identical to data/czechia/schema.json. Only country-specific descriptive semantics and authorities are adapted for Italian CAP geography. One CAP remains one record even when it covers multiple Comuni. city, county and state contain all applicable official names as comma-separated values; district is reserved for a relevant sub-municipal locality. Research and locate facts across the full CAP territory, independently of Comune boundaries. representative_place and representative_point are orientation anchors for the whole CAP, not a representative Comune or serving post office. Do not introduce Italy-only technical fields or enum values.
